temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he has been keeping something from Christian and says he is in trouble, having not known how to tell him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Christian believes Jonathan is hiding something important from him; he feels anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. His suspicion is confirmed: Jonathan was hiding something and is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan has been concealing something important and is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious and suspicious, shifting to worried and concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To uncover the truth and learn more about Jonathan's trouble.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated, does not want to drag Christian into it, but admits he could use support and resources to get out of the mess.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan has been concealing something important and is in trouble.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Jonathan's trouble is serious and complicated, and he is willing to accept Christian's support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in serious trouble and needs help and resources; Christian can support him.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer help and support Jonathan through his trouble.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says he cannot be sure, but he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, while claiming he did not do anything illegal himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in serious trouble and needs help; Christian suspects it may be related to criminal activity.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, partially. His suspicion is strengthened: Jonathan may be entangled with criminal or wrong people, though Jonathan denies illegal actions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may be involved with the wrong people and possible criminal activity, but he claims he did nothing illegal.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate discreetly without alarming Jonathan and ensure his safety.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed; he tells Jonathan someone is trying to set him up and that he will gather more evidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may be involved with the wrong people and possible criminal activity, but he claims innocence; Christian is investigating.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. The investigation shifts his belief from possible criminal entanglement to Jonathan being framed and innocent of the setup.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed by someone, and Christian must clear his name.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gather evidence to prove Jonathan's innocence and clear his name.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian learns and tells Jonathan that the person behind the framing is someone close to and trusted by both of them.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is being framed by an unknown person, and Christian is gathering evidence to clear his name.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. He identifies the real culprit as a trusted mutual acquaintance, turning the situation into a betrayal.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Someone close to both Christian and Jonathan is responsible for framing Jonathan and must be brought to justice.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and bring them to justice.
